description: Queries where the Cosmos emulator is RIGHT but slate diverges — real slate gaps (cosmos-parity SKILL §5 'real gap'). We DO commit the correct Cosmos golden for these (so the expectation is recorded), but the hermetic replay treats them as EXPECTED divergences: it reports them instead of asserting equality, so the suite stays green while the gap is pinned and visible. If slate is fixed to match the golden, the replay prints a notice to promote the scenario out of this list.
